versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh said to Moses,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘I am Yahweh your God.
controles.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, I am the Lord your God.
controles.livre: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.

versos.hebraico: כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֧ה אֶֽרֶץ־מִצְרַ֛יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְשַׁבְתֶּם־בָּ֖הּ לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ וּכְמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֶֽרֶץ־כְּנַ֡עַן אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲנִי֩ מֵבִ֨יא אֶתְכֶ֥ם שָׁ֨מָּה֙ לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּ וּבְחֻקֹּתֵיהֶ֖ם לֹ֥א תֵלֵֽכוּ׃

controles.web: You shall not do as they do in the land of Egypt, where you lived: and you shall not do as they do in the land of Canaan, where I am bringing you; neither shall you walk in their statutes.
controles.kjv: After the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein ye dwelt, shall ye not do: and after the doings of the land of Canaan, whither I bring you, shall ye not do: neither shall ye walk in their ordinances.
controles.livre: Não fareis como fazem na terra do Egito, na qual morastes; nem fareis como fazem na terra de Canaã, à qual eu vos conduzo; nem andareis em seus estatutos.

versos.hebraico: אֶת־מִשְׁפָּטַ֧י תַּעֲשׂ֛וּ וְאֶת־חֻקֹּתַ֥י תִּשְׁמְר֖וּ לָלֶ֣כֶת בָּהֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: You shall do my ordinances, and you shall keep my statutes, and walk in them: I am Yahweh your God.
controles.kjv: Ye shall do my judgments, and keep mine ordinances, to walk therein: I am the Lord your God.
controles.livre: Meus regulamentos poreis por obra, e meus estatutos guardareis, andando neles: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.

versos.hebraico: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֤ם אֶת־חֻקֹּתַי֙ וְאֶת־מִשְׁפָּטַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָ֛ם הָאָדָ֖ם וָחַ֣י בָּהֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃ס

controles.web: You shall therefore keep my statutes and my ordinances; which if a man does, he shall live in them. I am Yahweh.
controles.kjv: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes, and my judgments: which if a man do, he shall live in them: I am the Lord.
controles.livre: Portanto meus estatutos e meus regulamentos guardareis, os quais fazendo o homem, viverá neles: Eu sou o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: אִ֥ישׁ אִישׁ֙ אֶל־כָּל־שְׁאֵ֣ר בְּשָׂר֔וֹ לֹ֥א תִקְרְב֖וּ לְגַלּ֣וֹת עֶרְוָ֑ה אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃ס

controles.web: “‘None of you shall approach anyone who are his close relatives, to uncover their nakedness: I am Yahweh.
controles.kjv: None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him, to uncover their nakedness: I am the Lord.
controles.livre: Nenhum homem se achegue a nenhuma próxima de sua carne, para descobrir sua nudez: Eu sou o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: עֶרְוַ֥ת אָבִ֛יךָ וְעֶרְוַ֥ת אִמְּךָ֖ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה אִמְּךָ֣ הִ֔וא לֹ֥א תְגַלֶּ֖ה עֶרְוָתָֽהּ׃ס

controles.web: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father, nor the nakedness of your mother: she is your mother. You shall not uncover her nakedness.
controles.kjv: The nakedness of thy father, or the nakedness of thy mother, shalt thou not uncover: she is thy mother; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
controles.livre: A nudez de teu pai, ou a nudez de tua mãe, não descobrirás: tua mãe é, não descobrirá sua nudez.

versos.hebraico: עֶרְוַ֥ת אֵֽשֶׁת־אָבִ֖יךָ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה עֶרְוַ֥ת אָבִ֖יךָ הִֽוא׃ס

controles.web: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife. It is your father’s nakedness.
controles.kjv: The nakedness of thy father’s wife shalt thou not uncover: it is thy father’s nakedness.
controles.livre: A nudez da mulher de teu pai não descobrirás; é a nudez de teu pai.

versos.hebraico: עֶרְוַ֨ת אֲחֽוֹתְךָ֤ בַת־אָבִ֨יךָ֙ א֣וֹ בַת־אִמֶּ֔ךָ מוֹלֶ֣דֶת בַּ֔יִת א֖וֹ מוֹלֶ֣דֶת ח֑וּץ לֹ֥א תְגַלֶּ֖ה עֶרְוָתָֽן׃ס

controles.web: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your sister, the daughter of your father, or the daughter of your mother, whether born at home, or born abroad.
controles.kjv: The nakedness of thy sister, the daughter of thy father, or daughter of thy mother, whether she be born at home, or born abroad, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover.
controles.livre: A nudez de tua irmã, filha de teu pai, ou filha de tua mãe, nascida em casa ou nascida fora, sua nudez não descobrirás.

versos.hebraico: עֶרְוַ֤ת בַּת־בִּנְךָ֙ א֣וֹ בַֽת־בִּתְּךָ֔ לֹ֥א תְגַלֶּ֖ה עֶרְוָתָ֑ן כִּ֥י עֶרְוָתְךָ֖ הֵֽנָּה׃ס

controles.web: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your son’s daughter, or of your daughter’s daughter, even their nakedness: for theirs is your own nakedness.
controles.kjv: The nakedness of thy son’s daughter, or of thy daughter’s daughter, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover: for theirs is thine own nakedness.
controles.livre: A nudez da filha de teu filho, ou da filha de tua filha, seu nudez não descobrirás, porque é a nudez tua.

versos.hebraico: עֶרְוַ֨ת בַּת־אֵ֤שֶׁת אָבִ֨יךָ֙ מוֹלֶ֣דֶת אָבִ֔יךָ אֲחוֹתְךָ֖ הִ֑וא לֹ֥א תְגַלֶּ֖ה עֶרְוָתָֽהּ׃ס

controles.web: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife’s daughter, conceived by your father, since she is your sister.
controles.kjv: The nakedness of thy father’s wife’s daughter, begotten of thy father, she is thy sister, thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
controles.livre: A nudez da filha da mulher de teu pai, gerada de teu pai, tua irmã é, sua nudez não descobrirás.

versos.hebraico: עֶרְוַ֥ת אֲחוֹת־אָבִ֖יךָ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה שְׁאֵ֥ר אָבִ֖יךָ הִֽוא׃ס

controles.web: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s sister: she is your father’s near kinswoman.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father’s sister: she is thy father’s near kinswoman.
controles.livre: A nudez da irmã de teu pai não descobrirás: é parente de teu pai.

versos.hebraico: עֶרְוַ֥ת אֲחֽוֹת־אִמְּךָ֖ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה כִּֽי־שְׁאֵ֥ר אִמְּךָ֖ הִֽוא׃ס

controles.web: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister: for she is your mother’s near kinswoman.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother’s sister: for she is thy mother’s near kinswoman.
controles.livre: A nudez da irmã de tua mãe não descobrirás: porque parente de tua mãe é.

versos.hebraico: עֶרְוַ֥ת אֲחִֽי־אָבִ֖יךָ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה אֶל־אִשְׁתּוֹ֙ לֹ֣א תִקְרָ֔ב דֹּדָֽתְךָ֖ הִֽוא׃ס

controles.web: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s brother, you shall not approach his wife. She is your aunt.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father’s brother, thou shalt not approach to his wife: she is thine aunt.
controles.livre: A nudez do irmão de teu pai não descobrirás: não chegarás à sua mulher: é mulher do irmão de teu pai.

versos.hebraico: עֶרְוַ֥ת כַּלָּֽתְךָ֖ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה אֵ֤שֶׁת בִּנְךָ֙ הִ֔וא לֹ֥א תְגַלֶּ֖ה עֶרְוָתָֽהּ׃ס

controles.web: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your daughter-in-law: she is your son’s wife. You shall not uncover her nakedness.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter in law: she is thy son’s wife; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
controles.livre: A nudez de tua nora não descobrirás: mulher é de teu filho, não descobrirás sua nudez.

versos.hebraico: עֶרְוַ֥ת אֵֽשֶׁת־אָחִ֖יךָ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה עֶרְוַ֥ת אָחִ֖יךָ הִֽוא׃ס

controles.web: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother’s wife. It is your brother’s nakedness.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother’s wife: it is thy brother’s nakedness.
controles.livre: A nudez da mulher de teu irmão não descobrirás: é a nudez de teu irmão.

versos.hebraico: עֶרְוַ֥ת אִשָּׁ֛ה וּבִתָּ֖הּ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה אֶֽת־בַּת־בְּנָ֞הּ וְאֶת־בַּת־בִּתָּ֗הּ לֹ֤א תִקַּח֙ לְגַלּ֣וֹת עֶרְוָתָ֔הּ שַׁאֲרָ֥ה הֵ֖נָּה זִמָּ֥ה הִֽוא

controles.web: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter. You shall not take her son’s daughter, or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness; they are near kinswomen: it is wickedness.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, neither shalt thou take her son’s daughter, or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness; for they are her near kinswomen: it is wickedness.
controles.livre: A nudez da mulher e de sua filha não descobrirás: não tomarás a filha de seu filho, nem a filha de sua filha, para descobrir sua nudez: são parentes, é maldade.

versos.hebraico: וְאִשָּׁ֥ה אֶל־אֲחֹתָ֖הּ לֹ֣א תִקָּ֑ח לִצְרֹ֗ר לְגַלּ֧וֹת עֶרְוָתָ֛הּ עָלֶ֖יהָ בְּחַיֶּֽיהָ׃

controles.web: “‘You shall not take a wife to her sister, to be a rival, to uncover her nakedness, while her sister is yet alive.
controles.kjv: Neither shalt thou take a wife to her sister, to vex her, to uncover her nakedness, beside the other in her life time.
controles.livre: Não tomarás mulher juntamente com sua irmã, para fazê-la sua rival, descobrindo sua nudez diante dela em sua vida.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶל־אִשָּׁ֖ה בְּנִדַּ֣ת טֻמְאָתָ֑הּ לֹ֣א תִקְרַ֔ב לְגַלּ֖וֹת עֶרְוָתָֽהּ׃

controles.web: “‘You shall not approach a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is impure by her uncleanness.
controles.kjv: Also thou shalt not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is put apart for her uncleanness.
controles.livre: E não chegarás à mulher na separação de sua impureza, para descobrir sua nudez.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶל־אֵ֨שֶׁת֙ עֲמִֽיתְךָ֔ לֹא־תִתֵּ֥ן שְׁכָבְתְּךָ֖ לְזָ֑רַע לְטָמְאָה־בָֽהּ׃

controles.web: “‘You shall not lie carnally with your neighbor’s wife, and defile yourself with her.
controles.kjv: Moreover thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbour’s wife, to defile thyself with her.
controles.livre: Além disso, não terás ato carnal com a mulher de teu próximo, contaminando-te nela.

versos.hebraico: וּמִֽזַּרְעֲךָ֥ לֹא־תִתֵּ֖ן לְהַעֲבִ֣יר לַמֹּ֑לֶךְ וְלֹ֧א תְחַלֵּ֛ל אֶת־שֵׁ֥ם אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: “‘You shall not give any of your children to sacrifice to Molech; neither shall you profane the name of your God. I am Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt not let any of thy seed pass through the fire to Molech, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the Lord.
controles.livre: E não dês de tua descendência para fazê-la passar pelo fogo a Moloque; não contamines o nome de teu Deus: Eu sou o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶ֨ת־זָכָ֔ר לֹ֥א תִשְׁכַּ֖ב מִשְׁכְּבֵ֣י אִשָּׁ֑ה תּוֹעֵבָ֖ה הִֽוא׃

controles.web: “‘You shall not lie with a man, as with a woman. That is detestable.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it is abomination.
controles.livre: Não te deitarás com homem como com mulher: é abominação.

versos.hebraico: וּבְכָל־בְּהֵמָ֛ה לֹא־תִתֵּ֥ן שְׁכָבְתְּךָ֖ לְטָמְאָה־בָ֑הּ וְאִשָּׁ֗ה לֹֽא־תַעֲמֹ֞ד לִפְנֵ֧י בְהֵמָ֛ה לְרִבְעָ֖הּ תֶּ֥בֶל הֽוּא׃

controles.web: “‘You shall not lie with any animal to defile yourself with it; neither shall any woman give herself to an animal, to lie down with it: it is a perversion.
controles.kjv: Neither shalt thou lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith: neither shall any woman stand before a beast to lie down thereto: it is confusion.
controles.livre: Nem com nenhum animal terás ajuntamento contaminando-te com ele; nem mulher alguma se porá diante de animal para ajuntar-se com ele: é confusão.

versos.hebraico: אַל־תִּֽטַּמְּא֖וּ בְּכָל־אֵ֑לֶּה כִּ֤י בְכָל־אֵ֨לֶּה֙ נִטְמְא֣וּ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִ֥י מְשַׁלֵּ֖חַ מִפְּנֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: “‘Don’t defile yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations which I am casting out before you were defiled.
controles.kjv: Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out before you:
controles.livre: Em nenhuma destas coisas vos contaminareis; porque em todas estas coisas se poluíram as nações que eu expulso de diante de vós:

versos.hebraico: וַתִּטְמָ֣א הָאָ֔רֶץ וָאֶפְקֹ֥ד עֲוֺנָ֖הּ עָלֶ֑יהָ וַתָּקִ֥א הָאָ֖רֶץ אֶת־יֹשְׁבֶֽיהָ׃

controles.web: The land was defiled: therefore I punished its iniquity, and the land vomited out her inhabitants.
controles.kjv: And the land is defiled: therefore I do visit the iniquity thereof upon it, and the land itself vomiteth out her inhabitants.
controles.livre: E a terra foi contaminada; e eu visitei sua maldade sobre ela, e a terra vomitou seus moradores.

versos.hebraico: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֣ם אַתֶּ֗ם אֶת־חֻקֹּתַי֙ וְאֶת־מִשְׁפָּטַ֔י וְלֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּ מִכֹּ֥ל הַתּוֹעֵבֹ֖ת הָאֵ֑לֶּה הָֽאֶזְרָ֔ח וְהַגֵּ֖ר הַגָּ֥ר בְּתוֹכְכֶֽם׃

controles.web: You therefore shall keep my statutes and my ordinances, and shall not do any of these abominations; neither the native-born, nor the stranger who lives as a foreigner among you;
controles.kjv: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes and my judgments, and shall not commit any of these abominations; neither any of your own nation, nor any stranger that sojourneth among you:
controles.livre: Guardai, pois, vós meus estatutos e meus regulamentos, e não façais nenhuma de todas estas abominações: nem o natural nem o estrangeiro que peregrina entre vós.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֚י אֶת־כָּל־הַתּוֹעֵבֹ֣ת הָאֵ֔ל עָשׂ֥וּ אַנְשֵֽׁי־הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לִפְנֵיכֶ֑ם וַתִּטְמָ֖א הָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: (for all these abominations have the men of the land done, that were before you, and the land became defiled);
controles.kjv: (For all these abominations have the men of the land done, which were before you, and the land is defiled;)
controles.livre: (Porque todas estas abominações fizeram os homens da terra, que foram antes de vós, e a terra foi contaminada:)

versos.hebraico: וְלֹֽא־תָקִ֤יא הָאָ֨רֶץ֙ אֶתְכֶ֔ם בְּטַֽמַּאֲכֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑הּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר קָאָ֛ה אֶת־הַגּ֖וֹי אֲשֶׁ֥ר לִפְנֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: that the land not vomit you out also, when you defile it, as it vomited out the nation that was before you.
controles.kjv: That the land spue not you out also, when ye defile it, as it spued out the nations that were before you.
controles.livre: E a terra não vos vomitará, por havê-la contaminado, como vomitou à gente que foi antes de vós.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֚י כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַעֲשֶׂ֔ה מִכֹּ֥ל הַתּוֹעֵב֖וֹת הָאֵ֑לֶּה וְנִכְרְת֛וּ הַנְּפָשׁ֥וֹת הָעֹשֹׂ֖ת מִקֶּ֥רֶב עַמָּֽם׃

controles.web: “‘For whoever shall do any of these abominations, even the souls that do them shall be cut off from among their people.
controles.kjv: For whosoever shall commit any of these abominations, even the souls that commit them shall be cut off from among their people.
controles.livre: Porque qualquer um que fizer alguma de todas estas abominações, as pessoas que as fizerem, serão eliminadas dentre seu povo.

versos.hebraico: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֣ם אֶת־מִשְׁמַרְתִּ֗י לְבִלְתִּ֨י עֲשׂ֜וֹת מֵחֻקּ֤וֹת הַתּֽוֹעֵבֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נַעֲשׂ֣וּ לִפְנֵיכֶ֔ם וְלֹ֥א תִֽטַּמְּא֖וּ בָּהֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃פ

controles.web: Therefore you shall keep my requirements, that you do not practice any of these abominable customs, which were practiced before you, and that you do not defile yourselves with them. I am Yahweh your God.’”
controles.kjv: Therefore shall ye keep mine ordinance, that ye commit not any one of these abominable customs, which were committed before you, and that ye defile not yourselves therein: I am the Lord your God.
controles.livre: Guardai, pois, minha ordenança, não fazendo das práticas abomináveis que tiveram lugar antes de vós, e não vos torneis abomináveis nelas: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.
